lines.en: label dormwarsfive14:
{i}The following morning...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}第二天早上……{/i}

lines.en: show monday
$ day = 1
$ totaldays += 1
scene sky
: Okay, girls! Gather round so we can begin the closing ceremony and start the countdown to 363 days from now when we do this all over again!
lines.zh: : 好了，姑娘们！都聚过来，我们要开始闭幕式了，然后就可以开始倒计时——还有 363 天，我们就会把这一切再来一遍！

lines.en: : You mean unless time has other plans for us and winds up changing the schedule of the universe.
lines.zh: : 你是说，除非时间对我们另有安排，最后把宇宙的时间表给改了。

lines.en: : Right. Because that is a thing that happens.
lines.zh: : 对。因为这种事确实会发生嘛。

lines.en: : Hey. You never know.
lines.zh: : 嘿。谁说得准呢。

lines.en: scene endofwarfive1
: Well, girls — it’s been another great year of the Dorm Wars, and we couldn’t have done it without you. Because, without you, there would obviously be no one to engage in war with.
lines.zh: : 嗯，姑娘们——又是一届精彩的宿舍大战，没有你们我们可办不成。因为，没有你们，显然就没有人能跟我们打仗了。

lines.en: : It’d just be me in my room fighting with myself. So basically a regular night. And who wants a regular night {i}every{/i} night? Not me. That’s for sure.
lines.zh: : 那就只剩我一个人在房间里跟自己打。所以基本上就是个普通的夜晚。可谁想要{i}每天{/i}晚上都普通呢？反正我不想要。这点我敢肯定。

lines.en: : In fact, I don’t want a regular night {i}any{/i} night because it’s my personal policy to always try and find something exciting about each and every day!
lines.zh: : 事实上，我{i}哪天{/i}都不想要普通的夜晚，因为我的个人信条是：每一天都要努力找出一点让人兴奋的东西！

lines.en: : Uta. The results?
lines.zh: : Uta。公布结果吧？

lines.en: : {size=-1}What I’m saying here is that it’s important to always stay positive! Especially in these trying times where we’re all becoming acutely aware of what each other are doing behind each other’s backs!{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-1}我想说的是，保持积极的心态很重要！尤其是在这种艰难的时刻——我们都越来越清楚地意识到彼此背着对方在干些什么！{/size}

lines.en: scene endofwarfive2
: We’re what now?
lines.zh: : 我们怎么着了？

lines.en: : I just hope that, regardless of the results, no one harbors any ill will against one another and that we can all continue living together as a big ol' dysfunctional girl family! The end.
lines.zh: : 我只是希望，不管结果如何，都不要有人对彼此心怀怨恨，我们还能继续像一个又大又乱七八糟的女生大家庭一样住在一起！说完了。

lines.en: : Somebody wanna spill the tea or am I too old to sit with y’all now?
lines.zh: : 有谁想来爆点料吗，还是说我现在已经老到没法和你们坐在一起了？

lines.en: : There’s no “tea” at all. I think Uta just didn’t sleep very well.
lines.zh: : 根本没什么料。我觉得 Uta 只是没睡好。

lines.en: : Well, it was kind of hard to since we only had one bed and five of us decided to sleep in it together!
lines.zh: : 嗯，当然睡不好了，因为我们只有一张床，而我们五个人决定一起睡在上面！

lines.en: scene endofwarfive3
: Honestly, I’m just glad I survived. Tsuneyo is a very {i}strong{/i} cuddler.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我能活下来就已经很高兴了。Tsuneyo 抱人的{i}力气可真大{/i}。

lines.en: : You should just be happy you were kept safe.
lines.zh: : 你应该庆幸自己被保护得很安全才对。

lines.en: : I almost died.
lines.zh: : 我差点没命。

lines.en: : So, can Imani read off the results now or do you want to just keep up Uta-chan’s story time for the rest of the morning?
lines.zh: : 那么，现在可以让 Imani 念结果了吗，还是你想让 Uta 的故事时间一直持续到中午？

lines.en: scene endofwarfive4
: I mean, now that we’ve got the day after the Dorm Wars classified as a national holiday, we don’t really need to take our time, right?
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，既然宿舍大战结束后的那天已经被定为国家假日了，我们其实不用那么赶时间，对吧？

lines.en: : It’s not a {i}national{/i} holiday, just a local one. And we owe it to Miss Imai for getting us the day off, so the least we can let her do is finish the job she loves.
lines.zh: : 那不是{i}国家{/i}假日，只是地方假日。而且我们能放这天假全靠 Imai 小姐，所以至少也该让她把她喜欢的工作做完。

lines.en: : Fair enough. Please proceed, Imani. We all love you.
lines.zh: : 说得也是。请继续吧，Imani。我们都爱你。

lines.en: scene endofwarfive5
: The final tally after adding everything together is as follows...
lines.zh: : 把所有分数加起来之后，最终统计如下……

lines.en: : Floor 1: [dormwars5floor1points].
lines.zh: : 一楼：[dormwars5floor1points]。

lines.en: : Floor 2: [dormwars5floor2points].
lines.zh: : 二楼：[dormwars5floor2points]。

lines.en: if dormwars5floor1points > dormwars5floor2points:
scene endofwarfive6
: Which means the winner is the first floor and we all get to listen to Makoto be a sore winner again as the team captain!
lines.zh: : 也就是说，获胜的是一楼，而作为队长，我们又将有幸聆听 Makoto 再一次展现她那输不起的赢家风范！

lines.en: : Why brag at all when I knew we were going to win from the start?
lines.zh: : 我一开始就知道我们会赢，那还吹什么牛？

lines.en: : You can brag, Makoto. It’s okay. You guys won fair and-
lines.zh: : 你可以吹的，Makoto。没关系的。你们赢得光明正大——

lines.en: scene endofwarfive7
: First floor superiority, bitch! You guys seriously thought you had a chance against us?! Are you dense or just stupid?! Just kidding! I already know the answer! It’s both!
lines.zh: : 一楼至上，贱人！你们真的以为自己有机会赢我们？！你们是迟钝还是纯粹蠢？！开个玩笑！我已经知道答案了！两个都是！

lines.en: : Feel better now that you’ve got that out of your system?
lines.zh: : 把这股劲儿发泄出来，现在舒服多了吧？

lines.en: scene endofwarfive8
: Much better. Thank you, Uta. And good work captaining your team — even {i}if{/i} it ultimately resulted in inevitable defeat. Which it did because I am better.
lines.zh: : 舒服多了。谢谢你，Uta。你带队也辛苦了——{i}尽管{/i}最终还是走向了那不可避免的失败。事实就是如此，因为我更强。

lines.en: : I hope Ayane overthrows you as captain one day. I really do.
lines.zh: : 我真希望有一天 Ayane 能把你的队长位子给掀了。我是真心的。

lines.en: : She can’t because she’s too busy being a loser like you.
lines.zh: : 她掀不了，因为她忙着像你一样当个废物。

lines.en: : Infighting aside, y’all have heard the winner! So go celebrate however you see fit or...do whatever it is you normally do to celebrate victories!
lines.zh: : 内讧先放一边，你们都听到获胜者了！所以去用你们喜欢的方式庆祝吧，或者……做你们平时庆祝胜利时会做的事！

lines.en: : I’ll be over here trying to stop these two from killing each other.
lines.zh: : 我就在这儿，负责阻止这两个人互掐致死。

lines.en: $ dormwarsfivefloor1win = True
if dormwars5floor2points > dormwars5floor1points:
scene endofwarfive9
: Which means that the second floor is the winner and- the Hell you lookin’ at me like that for, Makoto? Y’all were the ones who lost, not me.
lines.zh: : 也就是说，获胜的是二楼——还有，Makoto，你他妈那样看着我干什么？输的是你们，又不是我。

lines.en: : It’s just that you had the perfect opportunity right then to become a permanent ally of the first floor alliance and you squandered it in favor of-
lines.zh: : 只是你刚才本来有个绝佳的机会，可以成为一楼同盟的永久盟友，结果你却为了——

lines.en: : The actual winners?
lines.zh: : 真正的赢家？

lines.en: scene endofwarfive10
: That is correct, yes.
lines.zh: : 没错，是的。

lines.en: : Girls of floor two! On behalf of the entire world and all of Kumon-mi, thank you once again for the passion and dedication it took to crush the competition!
lines.zh: : 二楼的姑娘们！我代表全世界、代表整个 Kumon-mi，再次感谢你们为碾压对手所付出的热情与奉献！

lines.en: : And while there may not yet be a prize, we shall carry this victory in our hearts! Which is probably good for something! Just not on a monetary level!
lines.zh: : 虽然目前可能还没有奖品，但我们会把这场胜利铭记在心！这大概总有点用处！只是不是在金钱层面！

lines.en: scene endofwarfive11
: In the meantime, feel free to go celebrate however you see fit or...do whatever it is you normally do to celebrate victories!
lines.zh: : 同时，大家尽管去用喜欢的方式庆祝，或者……做你们平时庆祝胜利时会做的事！

lines.en: : I’ll be here trying to prevent Makoto from chasing after and subsequently assassinating all of you.
lines.zh: : 我就留在这儿，负责阻止 Makoto 追着你们然后把你们一个个暗杀掉。

lines.en: : No one ever lets me have any fun.
lines.zh: : 从来没人让我好好玩一玩。

lines.en: $ dormwarsfivefloor2win = True
if dormwars5floor1points == dormwars5floor2points:
scene endofwarfive12
: Which means that we’ve managed to end in a tie!
lines.zh: : 也就是说，我们打成了平局！

lines.en: : Tch. A tie is even worse than losing.
lines.zh: : 啧。平局比输了还糟。

lines.en: : How is a tie worse than losing?
lines.zh: : 平局怎么会比输了还糟？

lines.en: : Because we don’t have a concrete method of resolving it, which means that this will likely go down as a permanent draw and no one will ever know that my team was better.
lines.zh: : 因为我们没有明确的办法来打破僵局，也就是说这大概会被永久记为平局，而永远不会有人知道我的队伍更强。

lines.en: : If you guys are better, why didn’t you just win?
lines.zh: : 如果你们更强，那你们为什么不干脆赢下来呢？

lines.en: scene endofwarfive13
: Probably because some of us weren’t trying hard enough! Cough cough, Miku, cough!
lines.zh: : 大概是因为我们有些人不够努力吧！咳咳，Miku，咳！

lines.en: : Did this bitch just say “cough” out loud?
lines.zh: : 这丫头刚刚是把“咳”字念出声了吗？

lines.en: : Three times. Girl wins one court case and she’s suddenly the hottest thing in town.
lines.zh: : 三遍。赢了一场官司，这丫头就突然成了全城最红的人物。

lines.en: : Well, surely you won’t mind challenging me to another one to determine a {i}real{/i} winner then!
lines.zh: : 那么，你肯定不会介意再跟我打一场官司，好决出一个{i}真正{/i}的赢家吧！

lines.en: scene endofwarfive14
: Absolutely not. Our poor janitors have been through enough.
lines.zh: : 绝对不行。我们可怜的校工已经受够罪了。

lines.en: : Mngh...
lines.zh: : 唔嗯……

lines.en: : Why don’t we just call {i}both{/i} floors winners instead of saying it’s a tie?
lines.zh: : 要不我们干脆宣布两层楼{i}都{/i}是赢家，不说平局了？

lines.en: scene endofwarfive15
: DO I LOOK LIKE A JOKE TO YOU, MISS IMAI?!
lines.zh: : 我看起来像是在跟你开玩笑吗，IMAI 小姐？！

lines.en: : Hey! Nobody yells at Imani! She’s too cute to feel the unbridled rage of a sore loser!
lines.zh: : 喂！谁也不许冲 Imani 吼！她那么可爱，不该承受一个输不起的人那毫无节制的怒火！

lines.en: : She’d be cuter if she’d call it like it is and say that the first floor is better!
lines.zh: : 她要是能实话实说，承认一楼更强，那就更可爱了！

lines.en: : If you’re better, why didn’t you just win?
lines.zh: : 如果你们更强，那你们为什么不干脆赢下来呢？

lines.en: scene endofwarfive16
: AAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHHHHHH!!!!!!!
lines.zh: AAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHHHHHH!!!!!!!

lines.en: $ dormwarsfivetie = True
scene black
scene endofwarfive17
: Well, Yasu — how did you enjoy your first round of mostly sentient Dorm Wars?
lines.zh: : 那么，Yasu——你第一次参加这场基本还算神志清醒的宿舍大战，感觉如何？

lines.en: : It was so much quieter than normal! Which you may think is a good thing, but to me is very sad!
lines.zh: : 比平时安静太多了！你可能觉得这是好事，但对我来说却非常难过！

lines.en: : Oh no! Then why are we smiling?!
lines.zh: : 哦不！那我们为什么还在笑？！

lines.en: : Because you get sad whenever I look sad, so I’m just never going to look sad again!
lines.zh: : 因为我一露出难过的样子你就会难过，所以我决定以后再也不露出难过的样子了！

lines.en: : Please don’t feign your own joy to uphold mine! It puts me in a strange position that I do not like very much!
lines.zh: : 请不要为了成全我的快乐而假装你自己的快乐！这让我处在一个我非常不喜欢的奇怪境地！

lines.en: : Okay! I’ll just go back to being a miserable slug then!
lines.zh: : 好的！那我就回去继续当一只痛苦的鼻涕虫好了！

lines.en: : So it’s true that you are normal now?
lines.zh: : 所以说，你现在真的正常了？

lines.en: scene endofwarfive18
: Yasu was never {i}abnormal,{/i} Tsuneyo. She just has some...issues in regard to seeing and hearing things that we are currently battling through the use of medication.
lines.zh: : Yasu 从来都不是{i}不正常{/i}，Tsuneyo。她只是有些……在看到和听到某些东西方面的毛病，我们目前正在用药物来对付它。

lines.en: : It’s like when parents tell you to stop spending time with people who are a bad influence on you. I think. I don’t have parents.
lines.zh: : 就好像父母会叫你别再跟那些会带坏你的人混在一起。大概吧。我没有父母。

lines.en: scene endofwarfive19
: You may borrow my father. He is definitely alive.
lines.zh: : 你可以把我爸爸借给你。他绝对还活着。

lines.en: : He would probably die if he met me. My existence is a plague upon this earth.
lines.zh: : 他要见了我大概会当场死掉。我的存在就是降临在这世上的一场瘟疫。

lines.en: : Yasu — need I remind you that my mother {i}is{/i} your legal guardian now. Which means that, technically, you {i}do{/i} have parents.
lines.zh: : Yasu——需要我提醒你吗，我母亲现在已经{i}是{/i}你的法定监护人了。也就是说，严格来讲，你{i}确实{/i}有父母。

lines.en: : Oh, right. Sorry, Touka. That seemed too good to be true, so I imagined you were just playing a prank on me.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。抱歉，Touka。这好事听起来太不真实了，所以我还以为你是在捉弄我。

lines.en: : I would never.
lines.zh: : 我绝不会。

lines.en: : I would. But I’m the funny one, so that sort of thing is to be expected.
lines.zh: : 我会。但我是负责搞笑的那个，所以这种事也在意料之中。

lines.en: scene black
: Maybe you can teach {i}me{/i} to be funny! Then next year, {i}I{/i} can be in the comedy contest and not have to answer questions about horses!
lines.zh: : 也许你可以教{i}我{/i}变搞笑！那样明年的搞笑比赛{i}我{/i}就能参加，不用再去回答那些关于马的问题了！

lines.en: : At long last...an apprentice. Is this how it feels to have purpose?
lines.zh: : 终于……有徒弟了。这就是人生有了目标的感觉吗？

lines.en: : Do you feel an incontrollable light inside of you, begging to be unleashed upon the world?
lines.zh: : 你能感觉到体内有一道无法抑制的光，正乞求着被释放到这个世界上吗？

lines.en: : Something like that, yes.
lines.zh: : 差不多吧，是的。

lines.en: : Then yes, that is how that feels.
lines.zh: : 那就是了，就是那种感觉。

lines.en: : Perhaps the two of {i}you{/i} should just be roommates instead?...
lines.zh: : 也许{i}你{/i}们两位干脆当室友算了？……

lines.en: scene endofwarfive20
: Holy shit...you changed back? Why didn’t you tell me? I would have gone with you.
lines.zh: : 我操……你染回来了？为什么不告诉我？我本来可以陪你去的。

lines.en: : Just a...spur of the moment thing. Felt like making a change and stuff.
lines.zh: : 就是……一时兴起。感觉想换个样子什么的。

lines.en: scene endofwarfive21
: Is it, like...a depression thing? Because I read online that some people get manic before that happens. Are you okay? Do you need anything? What should I-
lines.zh: : 这是……那个抑郁症的关系吗？因为我在网上看到说，有些人在那之前会先变得躁狂。你还好吗？你需要什么吗？我该怎么——

lines.en: : It’s not a depression thing, no. I just wanted to, like...get back to what I felt was {i}normal{/i} I guess.
lines.zh: : 不是抑郁症的关系，不是。我只是想……大概回到我觉得{i}正常{/i}的状态吧。

lines.en: : I’ve just had black hair for most of my life and- wait, why were you reading about depression?
lines.zh: : 我这辈子大部分时间都是黑头发，然后——等等，你为什么会去查抑郁症的东西？

lines.en: : Because I know you have it and I want to be there for you the next time it happens so you don’t hurt yourself anymore.
lines.zh: : 因为我知道你有抑郁症，我想在下次它发作的时候陪在你身边，这样你就不会再伤害自己了。

lines.en: scene endofwarfive22
: {i}Chika...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Chika……{/i}

lines.en: : That...huh. That...felt weirdly embarrassing to say for...some reason.
lines.zh: : 这……嗯。这句话……说出来莫名地让人不好意思……不知道为什么。

lines.en: : You really did that for me?
lines.zh: : 你真的为我做了那种事？

lines.en: scene endofwarfive23
: Is that weird? It’s probably weird, right? I should back off. I’m getting clingy again.
lines.zh: : 这很奇怪吗？大概挺奇怪的吧？我应该退一步。我又开始黏人了。

lines.en: scene endofwarfive24
: It’s not weird at all...it’s really cute. And I’m really happy you’re looking out for me.
lines.zh: : 一点都不奇怪……真的很可爱。你能这样关心我，我真的很开心。

lines.en: : I have horrible news, though. I kissed your boyfriend.
lines.zh: : 不过，我有个很糟糕的消息。我亲了你男朋友。

lines.en: scene endofwarfive25
: I figured I should tell you before you say anything else nice about me and it becomes harder for me to tell you and I ultimately suppress it for the rest of my life.
lines.zh: : 我想，在你再说别的夸我的话之前，我应该先告诉你，不然我就越来越难开口，最后大概会把它憋一辈子。

lines.en: : I don’t regret it either.
lines.zh: : 我也不后悔。

lines.en: scene endofwarfive26
: So yeah, I guess we’re rivals now.
lines.zh: : 所以，是啊，我想我们现在是情敌了。

lines.en: : I’ve finally accepted who I have feelings for.
lines.zh: : 我终于接受了自己喜欢的人是谁。

lines.en: : Are you mad?
lines.zh: : 你生气了吗？

lines.en: : Just...
lines.zh: : 只是……

lines.en: : A little...shocked...
lines.zh: : 有点……震惊……

lines.en: : You want to hear more about it? Or would that be weird? Cause I’ll tell you. And I haven’t even told Futaba yet.
lines.zh: : 你想听更多细节吗？还是那样会很怪？因为我会告诉你的。而且我连 Futaba 都还没说呢。

lines.en: : You’ll...tell me about...kissing my boyfriend?
lines.zh: : 你会……跟我说……亲我男朋友的事？

lines.en: : Mhm. Then you can tell me about how {i}you{/i} kiss your boyfriend and we can compare strategies. I’m still new to boy-kissing, so I could use the help.
lines.zh: : 嗯哼。然后{i}你{/i}也可以跟我说说你是怎么亲你男朋友的，我们还能交流一下技巧。我亲男生还是新手，需要指点。

lines.en: : You’re totally mad. I can see your face getting redder.
lines.zh: : 你绝对是生气了。我能看见你的脸越来越红。

lines.en: : Yeah...I...
: There's...some anger there...
lines.zh: : 确实……有点火气……

lines.en: : Just...uh...
: The reason for that...might be...kinda...{i}different{/i} from...what you’re expecting?...
lines.zh: : 而那个原因……可能……有点……跟你以为的{i}不太一样{/i}？……

lines.en: scene black
: I...I’ll be right back! Hahah!...Don’t...don’t go anywhere!
lines.zh: : 我……我马上就回来！哈哈！……别……别走开啊！

lines.en: : Okaaaay! But please don’t tell anyone else yet! This is still a secret, I think!
lines.zh: : 好——吧！不过先别告诉别人啊！这应该还是个秘密呢！

lines.en: scene endofwarfive27
: At long last, I can finally eat in peace. I sure hope no one shows up to ruin it.
lines.zh: : 总算，我终于可以安安静静地吃顿饭了。真希望别有人跑来破坏它。

lines.en: scene endofwarfive28
: Hey, look. It’s Maya.
lines.zh: : 嘿，你看。是 Maya。

lines.en: : My god, what have I done?
lines.zh: : 我的天，我到底造了什么孽？

lines.en: : So what? Ain’t you two, like...sworn enemies or some shit?
lines.zh: : 所以呢？你们俩不是……死对头之类的吗？

lines.en: : Star-crossed lovers is more like it.
lines.zh: : 说是命运多舛的恋人还差不多。

lines.en: scene endofwarfive29
: No it’s fucking not! And don’t even think about coming over here to-
lines.zh: : 才他妈不是！而且你想都别想过来——

lines.en: scene endofwarfive30
: Hi.
: ...make it even worse.
lines.zh: : ……让它变得更糟。

lines.en: : Whatcha doing all by yourself? Where’s Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你一个人在这儿干什么呢？Sensei 呢？

lines.en: : Maybe she’s like a lizard and just won’t see me if I don’t move?
lines.zh: : 也许她跟蜥蜴一样，只要我别动，她就看不见我了？

lines.en: : I’m not a lizard, I’m a girl.
lines.zh: : 我不是蜥蜴，我是女生。

lines.en: : Sounds exactly like what a lizard would say.
lines.zh: : 这话听着完全就是蜥蜴会说的话。

lines.en: : For what it’s worth, I ain’t convinced she’s human either. Thinkin’ more alien than animal, though.
lines.zh: : 怎么说呢，我也不太信她是人类。不过我觉得与其说是动物，不如说是外星人。

lines.en: : Well, whatever she is, I would like her to leave. And if you can get her to do that, I am willing to part with a sandwich.
lines.zh: : 嗯，不管她是什么，我只希望她赶紧走。如果你能让她走，我愿意忍痛割爱一个三明治。

lines.en: : Noriko, leave. I’m hungry.
lines.zh: : Noriko，走吧。我饿了。

lines.en: : But I don’t want to leave. I’m facing the final boss of friendship right now.
lines.zh: : 可我不想走。我现在正在挑战友情的最终 BOSS。

lines.en: : And failing quite miserably, at that.
lines.zh: : 而且还败得相当惨。

lines.en: : Oh, I know. I’m just trying to learn the fight so I can make it further on subsequent attempts.
lines.zh: : 哦，我知道。我只是想摸清这一战的套路，好让下一次能打得更远一点。

lines.en: : If you haven’t learned it yet, chances are you never-
lines.zh: : 要是你到现在还没摸清，那多半你这辈子都——

lines.en: : Damn, you two are really fucking gay.
lines.zh: : 靠，你们两个可真他妈的基。

lines.en: scene endofwarfive31
: Right?
lines.zh: : 是吧？

lines.en: : No, we’re not! I hate her no matter {i}how{/i} many times she tries to approach me and make me feel bad about that!
lines.zh: : 不，我们才不是！我讨厌她，不管她凑过来{i}多少次{/i}、试图让我为此内疚都一样！

lines.en: : She’s been like this forever. It’s okay, though. I’m used to unwarranted vitriol in response to adoration as a younger sibling.
lines.zh: : 她一直都这样。不过没关系。身为妹妹，我早就习惯了——用一腔热爱换来无端的刻薄。

lines.en: : The fuck’s there to adore about Ponytail? Seems like she’s just another member of Sensei’s fuckin’ cum-crowd.
lines.zh: : 那个马尾辫有什么好热爱的？看着不就是 Sensei 那群精液粉丝团里的又一个成员嘛。

lines.en: : Cum crowd?
lines.zh: : 精液粉丝团？

lines.en: : Love squad!
lines.zh: : 是恋爱小队！

lines.en: : That’s {i}worse{/i} than what I said. Least you can blame sex on impulses. Can’t do that with love.
lines.zh: : 这可比我说得还{i}糟{/i}。至少性还能推给冲动。爱可没法这么推。

lines.en: scene endofwarfive32
: She’s got a point.
lines.zh: : 她说得有道理。

lines.en: : I know! And that just pisses me off even more!
lines.zh: : 我知道！而这只会让我更火大！

lines.en: scene black
: What do you have in your picnic basket? Can I look?
lines.zh: : 你的野餐篮里装了什么？我能看看吗？

lines.en: : No! Don’t fucking touch that!
lines.zh: : 不行！别他妈碰那个！

lines.en: : Why? I just want to make sure you’re eating healthy. You’re a growing girl, Maya. It’s important to get all of your nutrients.
lines.zh: : 为什么？我只是想确认你吃得健康。你还在长身体呢，Maya。摄取足够营养很重要的。

lines.en: : So fucking gay.
lines.zh: : 真他妈的基。

lines.en: : It’s all her! I just wanted to be alone!
lines.zh: : 全是她的问题！我只是想一个人待着！

lines.en: scene endofwarfive33
: So, Io! How’d your date with Sensei go? Wanted to ask ya at the strip club yesterday, but you didn’t show up. You got somethin’ against strippers?
lines.zh: : 那么，Io！你和 Sensei 的约会怎么样？昨天在脱衣舞俱乐部就想问你了，结果你没来。你对跳脱衣舞的有意见？

lines.en: : Yes. I think it’s gross and abhorrent for someone to put their body on display like that.
lines.zh: : 是的。我觉得把自己身体那样展示出来，既恶心又可憎。

lines.en: : I disagree. I think it’s liberating.
lines.zh: : 我不同意。我觉得那是一种解放。

lines.en: : And I think the fact that Kirin disagrees with me is further proof that I am justified in holding the correct opinion.
lines.zh: : 而我觉得，Kirin 反对我这一点，恰恰进一步证明了我持有正确观点是站得住脚的。

lines.en: : Either way! Still wanna know what went down. Was kinda hopin’ I’d get chosen for that contest this year, but I ain’t really good at that dating stuff.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样！我还是想知道到底发生了什么。我本来还有点盼着今年那个比赛能选中我，不过我确实不太擅长约会这种事。

lines.en: scene endofwarfive34
: Me neither. We just hung out inside of a tunnel and discovered a cliff that led to nowhere.
lines.zh: : 我也不擅长。我们只是在一条隧道里待着，然后发现了一处通向虚无的悬崖。

lines.en: : But I’m pretty sure I can count that as a success since I didn’t annoy him to the point where he felt like he needed to push me off of it.
lines.zh: : 但我觉得这可以算作一次成功，毕竟我没烦到让他觉得非把我从那上面推下去不可。

lines.en: : A...cliff that led to nowhere?
lines.zh: : 一处……通向虚无的悬崖？

lines.en: : Poor Io. The date was so bad that she’s gotta make stuff up about it.
lines.zh: : 可怜的 Io。约会糟到她非得编点东西出来不可。

lines.en: scene endofwarfive35
: I’m serious, though! There’s this giant hole in the city so deep that you can’t even see the bottom of it! I’m pretty sure it’s the one my old school fell into!
lines.zh: : 我说真的！城里有个巨大的洞，深得根本看不见底！我很确定那就是我以前的学校塌进去的那个洞！

lines.en: : Did you try getting somebody to go stand at the top and yell so you can test that theory?
lines.zh: : 你有没有找人站到上面去喊一声，好验证一下你这个理论？

lines.en: : No, but I’m working on it.
lines.zh: : 没有，但我正在想办法。

lines.en: : I mean...we ain’t got anythin’ goin’ on after this. We’ll come with ya if ya wanna show us your hole, Io.
lines.zh: : 我是说……之后我们也没别的事。如果你想让我们看看你的洞，我们就陪你去，Io。

lines.en: : Please never speak those words to me again.
lines.zh: : 请你永远别再对我说这句话了。

lines.en: : She just means that we’ll help you with your experiment.
lines.zh: : 她只是说我们会帮你做那个实验。

lines.en: : I’m well aware of what she means, but wording is important.
lines.zh: : 我很清楚她是什么意思，但措辞很重要。

lines.en: scene endofwarfive36
: Besides, it’s a...secret hole. And I don’t want to show you how to get there from the bottom.
lines.zh: : 再说，那是个……秘密的洞。而且我不想教你们怎么从底下进去。

lines.en: : You don’t believe me, do you?
lines.zh: : 你们不相信我，是吧？

lines.en: : Poor Io. The date was so bad that she’s gotta make stuff up about it.
lines.zh: : 可怜的 Io。约会糟到她非得编点东西出来不可。

lines.en: scene black
: {i}Hah...{/i}yeah. Knew that was coming.
lines.zh: : {i}哈……{/i}是啊。我就知道会这样。

lines.en: : Just...
lines.zh: : 只是……

lines.en: : It was a good date. I think.
lines.zh: : 那是一次很好的约会。我想。

lines.en: : That’s all I can...really say.
lines.zh: : 我能……真正说出口的，也就这些了。

lines.en: if nodokathontwo3 == True:
scene endofwarfive37
: Is something wrong, Ayane?...You’ve been looking at me kind of weird all morning...
lines.zh: : 有什么不对劲吗，Ayane？……你一早上看我的眼神都有点怪……

lines.en: : I just...still can’t believe you’d do that to your mom, Sana.
lines.zh: : 我只是……还是不敢相信你会那样对你妈妈，Sana。

lines.en: : Nothing happened, though.
lines.zh: : 可是什么都没发生啊。

lines.en: : Nothing but the crazy threesome you had with Molly that we all got to watch on TV like one of those late night pay-per-view channels.
lines.zh: : 除了你和 Molly 那场疯狂的三人行，我们所有人都像看深夜付费频道一样在电视上看了一遍。

lines.en: scene endofwarfive38
: I’m sad we had to miss yours...Sensei made it sound like he had a lot of fun.
lines.zh: : 好遗憾我们错过了你那场……Sensei 说起来好像玩得很开心。

lines.en: : I’m sure there will be more. You’re welcome to watch the next one. I’ll give you a heads-up if I know it’s coming beforehand.
lines.zh: : 肯定还会有下一次的。欢迎你们来看下一场。如果我能提前知道，会先跟你们说一声的。

lines.en: : Please do.
lines.zh: : 请务必告诉我。

lines.en: : Have you at least talked to her at all, Sana?
lines.zh: : 你至少跟她谈过了吗，Sana？

lines.en: scene endofwarfive39
: Not yet. But I already know what I’m going to say when we {i}do{/i} talk.
lines.zh: : 还没有。但我已经知道等我们{i}谈{/i}的时候要说什么了。

lines.en: : I’ve known for a while, actually. Nodoka’s contest thing just gave me the push I needed to take the first step.
lines.zh: : 其实我知道这件事有一阵子了。Nodoka 那个比赛只是给了我迈出第一步所需要的推力。

lines.en: : Toward {i}what{/i} exactly? Making your mom feel like shit? Do you have any idea how many people would kill to have a mother who loves them as much as she loves you?
lines.zh: : 迈向{i}什么{/i}？让你妈生不如死？你知道有多少人愿意拿命去换一个像她那样爱你的母亲吗？

lines.en: scene endofwarfive40
: I love her too, Ayane. I’m not lying when I say that.
lines.zh: : 我也爱她啊，Ayane。我说这句话的时候没有在撒谎。

lines.en: : Then {i}why{/i} would you put her through that, Sana? I’m so...so disappointed in you.
lines.zh: : 那你{i}为什么{/i}还要让她承受那些，Sana？我真是……对你太失望了。

lines.en: : You just don’t get it. We’re different from most families. Something like this won’t hurt us in the long run. It’ll only bring us closer together.
lines.zh: : 你就是不懂。我们跟大多数家庭不一样。这种事长远来看伤不到我们。它只会让我们靠得更近。

lines.en: : May I speak as one of those people who {i}does{/i} long for the type of mother Sana’s seems to be?
lines.zh: : 我可以作为一个{i}渴望{/i}拥有 Sana 那种母亲的人说几句吗？

lines.en: scene endofwarfive41
: I shan’t pretend to understand your situation as I know the relationship one has with their mother can not be easily explained or understood.
lines.zh: : 我不会假装理解你的处境，因为我知道一个人和母亲之间的关系，无法轻易解释或理解。

lines.en: : But I ask you — if she were gone tomorrow and the last thing she heard from her daughter was what you recorded on that tape...how would that make you feel?
lines.zh: : 但我想问你——如果她明天就不在了，而她从女儿那里听到的最后一句话，就是你在那盘录像带上录下的内容……你会作何感想？

lines.en: : My mom’s...not going anywhere, though.
lines.zh: : 可我妈妈……哪儿都不会去啊。

lines.en: : That’s what I thought too.
lines.zh: : 我也是这么想的。

lines.en: scene endofwarfive42
: And Ami...and Ayane.
lines.zh: : 还有 Ami……还有 Ayane。

lines.en: : Each one of us lost something before we had time to prepare for it. Which is why your actions seem...questionable to us.
lines.zh: : 我们每个人都在还没来得及做好准备的时候失去了什么。所以我们才会觉得你的行为……有问题。

lines.en: : You...did the same thing with Haruka, though. You’re guilty too...
lines.zh: : 可你……也和 Haruka 做过同样的事啊。你也有罪……

lines.en: : Haruka is not my mother.
lines.zh: : Haruka 不是我的母亲。

lines.en: : Well said, Molly.
lines.zh: : 说得好，Molly。

lines.en: scene endofwarfive43
: You guys, just...
lines.zh: : 你们大家，只是……

lines.en: : You don’t get it.
lines.zh: : 你们不懂。

lines.en: scene endofwarfive44
: I’ll...see you back at the dorms, I guess.
lines.zh: : 那我……就回宿舍再见了，我想。

lines.en: : Work is going to be very awkward today, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 今天上班一定会很尴尬，对吧？

lines.en: : I can’t believe you guys put that on video.
lines.zh: : 我真不敢相信你们把那个拍成了录像。

lines.en: scene black
: The horny mind is a dangerous one...
lines.zh: : 发情的大脑是很危险的东西……

lines.en: : And I suffer its consequences nearly every single day...
lines.zh: : 而我几乎每一天都在承受它的后果……

lines.en: scene endofwarfive45
: Well, gang. We did it. We survived another Dorm Wars. And Nodoka didn’t traumatize anybody this time, so I think we can call that a win.
lines.zh: : 好了，各位。我们做到了。我们又挺过了一届宿舍大战。而且 Nodoka 这次没给任何人留下心理创伤，所以我觉得这可以算一次胜利。

lines.en: : It’s not my fault our classmates are so easily traumatized. I can’t even fathom how they’d fare in facing what Shiori had to.
lines.zh: : 我们的同学那么容易留下心理创伤，这可不是我的错。我甚至无法想象，如果他们要面对 Shiori 所面对的东西，会是什么下场。

lines.en: : Who?
: Some girl Nodoka’s been talking about since we were kids. I think it’s her imaginary friend.
lines.zh: : 一个 Nodoka 从我们小时候就一直念叨的女孩。我觉得那是她想象出来的朋友。

lines.en: : She’s real. She’s just somewhere else.
lines.zh: : 她是真的。她只是在别的地方。

lines.en: : Your mind?
lines.zh: : 你脑子里？

lines.en: : My mother’s.
lines.zh: : 我母亲的脑子里。

lines.en: : Now, if you don’t mind, I’d like to get back to my book.
lines.zh: : 现在，如果你们不介意，我想继续看我的书了。

lines.en: scene endofwarfive46
: And then there were two.
lines.zh: : 于是，只剩两个人了。

lines.en: : And then there were two...
lines.zh: : 于是，只剩两个人了……

lines.en: : You’ve seemed to be in a better mood lately, Otoha. Is there...any reason for that? Or...
lines.zh: : 你最近心情看起来好多了，Otoha。有什么……原因吗？还是说……

lines.en: : You seem to be worse. Is there any {i}reason{/i} for that? Or...
lines.zh: : 你看起来更糟了。有什么{i}原因{/i}吗？还是说……

lines.en: : Worse?...Really?
lines.zh: : 更糟？……真的吗？

lines.en: : Why do you say that?...
lines.zh: : 为什么这么说？……

lines.en: : Oh, no reason.
lines.zh: : 哦，没什么原因。

lines.en: : Just, if you’re going to make yourself throw up, you should do it in a bathroom the rest of us don’t have access to.
lines.zh: : 只是，如果你要让自己吐出来的话，应该去一个我们其他人用不了的洗手间里吐。

lines.en: scene endofwarfive47
: You want to talk about it?
lines.zh: : 你想聊聊吗？

lines.en: : I was sick.
lines.zh: : 我当时是身体不舒服。

lines.en: : That’s no good. Maybe we should tell Imani then? I’m sure she knows a doctor.
lines.zh: : 那可不行。那我们要不要告诉 Imani？我肯定她认识医生。

lines.en: : Hey...look at me.
lines.zh: : 嘿……看着我。

lines.en: : Why? It’s...not like there’s anything {i}you{/i} can do about it.
lines.zh: : 为什么？反正……{i}你{/i}又帮不上什么忙。

lines.en: : Didn’t say there was. I know a trick, though.
lines.zh: : 我又没说能帮上。不过我知道一个法子。

lines.en: scene endofwarfive48
: A trick to cure bulimia? That’s a new one.
lines.zh: : 治暴食症的法子？这倒是新鲜。

lines.en: : A trick to make you feel guilty. Worth a shot since I assume you’ve tried everything else, yeah?
lines.zh: : 一个让你产生愧疚感的法子。值得一试吧，毕竟我猜你别的办法都试过了，对吧？

lines.en: : Hate to break it to you, but I feel plenty guilty as is. What’s the trick?
lines.zh: : 不想让你失望，但我现在就已经够愧疚的了。是什么法子？

lines.en: : Just this. Just keep your eyes on mine.
lines.zh: : 就这样。就这么盯着我的眼睛。

lines.en: scene endofwarfive49
: You’re not going to try to steal my heart like you did Rin’s, are you?
lines.zh: : 你不会想像对 Rin 那样把我的心偷走吧？

lines.en: : And wipe out an entire dorm room? Nah. I’m not {i}that{/i} evil.
lines.zh: : 然后搞垮整整一间宿舍？不会。我还没{i}那么{/i}坏。

lines.en: : Just a trick I learned from my mom. Whenever I used to lie about stuff, she’d make me look her in the eyes for sixty seconds.
lines.zh: : 只是我从我妈妈那儿学来的法子。以前我每次撒谎，她都会让我盯着她的眼睛看六十秒。

lines.en: : Never pried or accused me of anything. Just sat there and stared.
lines.zh: : 她从不追问，也从不指控我什么。只是坐在那里看着我。

lines.en: : The first ten seconds were always easy. The next ten were awkward and uncomfortable.
lines.zh: : 头十秒总是很轻松。接下来的十秒变得尴尬又不舒服。

lines.en: : The forty after that, though? I just felt like an idiot. Like she saw through me completely, and it made me think twice about trying to hide or lie about stuff.
lines.zh: : 可之后的四十秒呢？我只觉得自己像个傻子。就好像她把我彻底看穿了，让我以后再想隐瞒或撒谎时都会三思。

lines.en: : And you think that’ll work for me?
lines.zh: : 而你觉得这对我也有用？

lines.en: : Probably not.
lines.zh: : 大概没用。

lines.en: : But it still feels good to be seen, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: : 但被人看见的感觉还是挺好的，不是吗？

lines.en: : So long as it’s not {i}me{/i} doing the seeing.
lines.zh: : 只要被看的不是{i}我{/i}就行。

lines.en: : Hm.
scene endofwarfive50
: Hahah...
lines.zh: : 哈哈……

lines.en: : I...I think we got to the...awkward part...
lines.zh: : 我……我觉得我们……到那个尴尬的部分了……

lines.en: : That part’s always the worst.
lines.zh: : 那一部分总是最难熬的。

lines.en: : Come on. Let’s go get tea or something.
lines.zh: : 走吧。我们去喝点茶什么的。

lines.en: if nodokathontwo3 == True:
scene endofwarfive51
: You like tea, right?
lines.zh: : 你喜欢喝茶吧？

lines.en: : I’m quite partial to jasmine, actually.
lines.zh: : 其实我特别偏爱茉莉花茶。

lines.en: : Two jasmines it is then.
lines.zh: : 那就来两杯茉莉花茶。

lines.en: scene endofwarfive52
: Nice weather we’re having, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 今天天气真好，是吧？

lines.en: scene endofwarfive53
: Feels a lot like paradise.
lines.zh: : 感觉很像天堂。

lines.en: scene endofwarfive54
: What did you just-
lines.zh: : 你刚刚——

lines.en: scene endofwarfive55
: Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : Just felt like you could use a hug.
lines.zh: : 就是觉得你大概需要一个拥抱。

lines.en: scene endofwarfive56
: Later, Nodoka! Remember to smile!
lines.zh: : 回头见，Nodoka！记得要笑哦！

lines.en: scene black
: I will...
lines.zh: : 我会的……

lines.en: $ dormwarsfive14 = True
scene bedroom_noon
The Dorm Wars have come to an end...
lines.zh: 宿舍大战落下帷幕……

lines.en: But life moves on.
lines.zh: 但生活还要继续。

lines.en: What should I do now?
lines.zh: 现在，我该做点什么呢？

lines.en: jump ch4noonmenu
else:
